user.title: Connect HA Switchboard
user.description: Enter the discovered gateway URL (or the App host and port) and the same gateway token configured in the HA Switchboard App. Supervisor ingress authenticates the Web UI separately.

confirm.title: Confirm HA Switchboard
confirm.description: Connect to {gateway_url}. Home Assistant Core will maintain a redacted capability profile; the App must still reconcile it before control requests are ready.

hassio_confirm.title: Discovered HA Switchboard
hassio_confirm.description: Supervisor discovered a gateway at {gateway_url}. Validate it and let Home Assistant Core maintain its redacted capability profile?

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS gateway URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the gateway. Check that the App is running, the URL is correct, and the integration uses the same gateway token as the App.

abort.already_configured: This HA Switchboard gateway is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered gateway information is incomplete or invalid.
